description: Philip Morris USA Media Department fax cover sheet (logo, Date/To/Fax/From/# of pages fields filled in typed text, blank Comments lines, confidentiality notice).
note: Standard fax cover sheet; RVL-CDIP conventionally labels these form.

description: Page rotated 90 degrees; large serif title 'PEL's' and subtitle 'What are the scientific issues?' laid out as a single title slide.
note: Rotated landscape slide/overhead.

description: Scan of a cover (dark border/background, punch holes, Bates sticker) with large hand-lettered title 'TAC CUSTOMER SERVICES' and a '14/5.0' tab-like label at bottom. No fields to fill in.
note: Looks like a binder or folder cover with a handwritten title; nothing form-like on the page.

description: R.J. Reynolds Research Department ruled report sheet, 1957 'Monthly Report - Smoke Analyses', entirely handwritten text and tables of nicotine/total solids by cuts per inch.
note: Content is a research report, but the page is almost entirely handwriting on a printed ruled sheet.

description: Graphic cover with Liggett Group logo, large stylized arrows and 'Liggett & Myers Merchandising Program', 'Prepared for: Jim Turnipseed, Big Bear Markets'.
note: Promotional brochure/program cover for retailers; advertisement plausible but it is a cover for a merchandising proposal rather than a consumer ad.

description: Page rotated; folder-tab outline with typed label 'Public Relations / Publications - Outside Transfer Files / Tobacco Associates Inc / Manuscripts Reviewed by Res Lab'; rest blank.
note: Classic folder-tab scan, rotated 90 degrees.

description: Rotated table titled 'BRAND: TRUE' listing merchandising programs (Plan I, Plan II, supermarket pack, chain drug store) with quantities, packs/cartons per month and dollar costs for coupons/stickers, with totals; footer '04/19/93 MERCH1'.
note: Cost/quantity planning table; reads as a budget spreadsheet. Rotated 90 degrees.

description: Large-font page with boxed title 'PROJECT WARSAW', prime and secondary objectives and a short table of delivery-profile ranges (nicotine, PMWNF, humectants).
note: Overhead/slide-like typography and sparse bullet layout; could also be a page of an internal research summary.

description: RJR 'Interoffice Memorandum' with Subject, Date, To: Mr. Sam Witt, From: Charles Nystrom, commenting on a Reader's Digest article with quoted excerpts.
note: Explicitly headed Interoffice Memorandum with To/From/Subject block; no letter features (salutation, letterhead address, closing).

description: Lorillard Tobacco 'VIA FACSIMILE' cover sheet with To/Fax No/From/Date/Number of pages fields filled in by hand, plus handwritten notes at top.
note: Fax cover sheet.

description: Rotated, nearly blank scan of a binder/folder cover: dark spine strip on left, small tab label '1151', Bates number, tab edges at bottom. No text content.
note: Only a cover with a number; nothing indicates a scientific report on this page.

description: German test-plan amendment form 'Prüfplanänderung' for study 'Biological Activity of CSS and FSS': boxed fields (Prüfleiter, Datum, Autor, Gegenstand, Begründung, Änderung), typed and handwritten entries, DATE-IN stamp.
note: Research-related, but the page itself is a boxed fill-in amendment form; form fits better.

description: Material Safety Data Sheet for compressed argon (MG Industries), two reduced pages on one sheet: substance identification, physical data, fire hazard, transportation data.
note: MSDS pages are product/technical spec sheets.

description: Material Safety Data Sheet for Amercoat 385 Cure (Ameron), sections on ingredients with exposure limits, physical data, fire/explosion, health hazards.
note: MSDS.

description: Almost blank page with one short handwritten word written sideways (illegible, possibly a name) and a Bates number.
note: Fits the RVL-CDIP folder-cover pattern (near blank with short label), but no folder edges/tab are visible; could equally be a blank or back page.

description: Mostly blank page with a folder/tab outline (diagonal corner, dotted fold line) and a handwritten label written sideways: 'PR156, Calculations, 2x2 Chevron cut RL, BC20-0118'.
note: Folder cover with handwritten label; rotated.

description: Rotated folder-tab scan with typed label 'HTI #1268/1269 - FINAL 10/4/83, To assess consumer acceptability of Marlboro Lights 85 mm NMF (with a cork tip)...'; rest blank.
note: Classic folder-tab scan.

description: Title page: 'Brown & Williamson Tobacco Corporation / Viceroy / July-December, 1983 / Directional Media Plan', prepared by Cunningham & Walsh, March 17, 1983.
note: Bare title page of a media plan; the plan may contain budgets but nothing on this page shows budget content. No good single category; chosen best is the 'nothing lets you decide' class.

description: Rotated Philip Morris computer printout 'Voucher Distribution Report by GL code, cost center, expense code' listing account numbers, vendor names, invoice and voucher numbers and dollar amounts with expense totals.
note: Accounting ledger/expense report; budget is the closest category. Mentions invoice numbers but is not an invoice.

description: Tobacco Institute check for $250 to Eric Robertson Campaign Cmte (12/05/95) with attached remittance stub listing invoice date, invoice no., description 'State Campaign Contrib.', invoice and net amounts.
note: Check plus remittance advice; invoice (or form) fits much better than budget.

description: Rotated RJR International sheet with only handwritten 'To: RJR Winston-Salem, Thomas A. Chepiga / From: RJR Moscow, Oksana ...' - a handwritten routing/cover page.
note: Cover/routing page; whatever followed may have been an invoice, but nothing on this page shows it.

description: Typed 'Political Campaign Contribution Request' with Recipient Information and Contribution Information fields (name, address, party, amount $200, account code, check pay to) and approval signature lines.
note: Internal request/approval form for a payment, not a bill from a vendor.

description: Rotated title slide 'Boys & Girls Club Budget 2000-2001' in large serif type with a globe graphic and decorative dot rows.
note: Slide styling is clear; budget is only the topic.

description: Home Testing Institute 'Filter Cigarette Report Form' (Appendix C p.2), Parts A and B with checkbox rating scales for taste, mildness and overall liking of test cigarettes B47 and L58.
note: Consumer product-test rating questionnaire.

description: Nearly blank page with the single word 'APPENDIX' centered.
note: Bare section divider; nothing indicates a resume.

description: 1948 typed internal note: 'Mr. J.A. Crowe, Asst. Chief of Manufacture' / 'H.R. Hanmer, Director of Research', date, paragraphs summarizing physical-property test results of Lucky Strikes, initials, 'Enclosure', cc list.
note: To/From block, no salutation or closing, internal cc list: memo style; letter also plausible.
